content.text:
## Who proposed EBD and when?

### Takeaway
Environment-Based Design (EBD) is a design methodology proposed by **Yong Zeng**, developed over roughly two decades and consolidated in his 2004 work and his 2011 ASME IDETC paper "Environment-Based Design (EBD)", with a foundational precursor co-authored with G. D. Cheng in 1991. No source gives a single "founding date"; the literature describes a phased development beginning with recursive logic (1991) and reaching its mature three-activity form by 2004–2015.

### Cited Findings
- "Zeng's research aims to understand and improve creative design activities. He has proposed a new design theory called Environment-Based Design." — [Concordia University faculty page, Dr. Yong Zeng](https://www.concordia.ca/ginacody/cybersecurity-intelligent-systems-eng/faculty/yong-zeng.html)
- Zeng was a Canada Research Chair (Tier II) in design science (2004–2014) and NSERC Chair in Aerospace Design Engineering (2015–2019); he joined Concordia in August 2003 after a PhD in Design Engineering from the University of Calgary (2001) and a prior PhD in Computational Mechanics from Dalian University of Technology (1992). — [Concordia University faculty page, Dr. Yong Zeng](https://www.concordia.ca/ginacody/cybersecurity-intelligent-systems-eng/faculty/yong-zeng.html)
- The ASME 2011 paper (paper no. DETC2011-48263, pp. 237–250, published online 12 June 2012) is authored by Yong Zeng, then at Concordia University, Montréal, and "summarizes a design methodology — Environment Based Design (EBD) — developed over the last two decades." — [ASME Digital Collection, "Environment-Based Design (EBD)"](https://asmedigitalcollection.asme.org/IDETC-CIE/proceedings-abstract/IDETC-CIE2011/54860/237/354151)
- The 2015 *Journal of Integrated Design and Process Science* article (Vol. 19, pp. 5–24) is single-authored by Yong Zeng, first published online 6 June 2015, and is described as "adapted from the author's publication 'Environment-Based Design' presented in ASME IDETC 2011." — [SAGE Journals, "Environment-Based Design (EBD): a Methodology for Transdisciplinary Design"](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/abs/10.3233/jid-2015-0004); bibliographic record at [Semantic Scholar](https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/Environment-Based-Design-(EBD)%3A-a-Methodology-for-Zeng/95982c95d61f2fd6dcc56d7bb5cf4751c593f255)
